title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.40647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. translated_title: 读取、分配、路由：面向像素空间生成式Transformer的角色耦合分词方法
translated_abstract: 像素空间生成式Transformer通常对每个图像块使用一个token，因此捕捉更精细的细节需要更多token，并使全局注意力的开销不断攀升。我们观察到，更精细的细节并不一定需要更多的全局通信：低频结构受益于全局信息交换，而高频细节可以在局部建模。基于这一洞察，我们提出了SpecSlot，一种像素空间整流流Transformer，它将输出细节与全局注意力序列的长度解耦。SpecSlot将每个空间锚点扩展为多个槽位，每个槽位被分配一段互不重叠的DCT系数频带，从而将锚点密度与频谱细分分离开来。每个锚点中只有频率最低的槽位参与全局注意力，而所有槽位均在局部进行交互。这使得模型能够在不扩大全局序列的情况下增加频谱细节。空间头进一步添加了局部校正……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SpecSlot，通过角色耦合的槽位分词将每个空间锚点按DCT频带拆分，仅让最低频槽位参与全局注意力、所有槽位进行局部交互，从而在不增加全局序列长度的情况下提升像素空间生成式Transformer的细节表达能力。
en_tdlr: SpecSlot decouples output detail from global attention sequence length by expanding each spatial anchor into role-coupled slots assigned disjoint DCT frequency bands, with only the lowest-frequency slot attending globally while all slots interact locally.
